description: Reviews mcp-guard runs that start processes, approve a trust baseline or write message bodies to disk. proxy, test-injection --run and --live (inspect, lock, ui, snapshot save) start the MCP servers named in a config or on the command line, or the given agent script. lock writes the lock file that later runs compare against, so running it approves the current tools, including a changed description. proxy --record-bodies keeps full JSON-RPC messages, which can contain secrets, in the journal. Static audits (inspect, scan, ui, snapshot save and diff without --live), journal export, test-injection without --run, and direct runs with --help or --version (except proxy, whose later arguments go to the server) are not matched by this extension; Guard's default handling for commands no rule matches still applies to them. Covers the mcp-guard and mcp-guard-audit executables (including .cmd/.exe). uvx, uv tool run and pipx run launches of the package are covered by command.package.python.
name: mcp-guard command protection
saferAlternatives: Run mcp-guard inspect CONFIG without --live: a static audit starts nothing.
Review inspect --lock output before writing a new lock.
